assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
There is a concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion events.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset.
The service is directly supported by diagnosis code G45.9.
The service is directly supported by diagnosis code R42.
The appeal addresses the payer's denial under PR-204.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Coverage limitations are strictly defined by the contracted policy terms.
The procedure falls outside the contracted coverage parameters.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the notice.
Failure to submit within the designated timeframe may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
